title: fix(agent): refuse parser-limited brief diffs
body:
Parser-limited or truncated diffs could produce a successful empty or repository-fallback `agent brief`; bounded intake could also mistake slash-heavy source text for a path header. This PR preserves valid empty/ordinary selection and refuses unexamined parser regions before owner lookup or inventory, through exit 2 / `diff_input_unsupported` / `downstream_consumable=false`.

**Current state: reviewed repair Ready; first hosted admission attempt failed before Rust gates.** Candidate `fc7e17a409cf81b99c2447a409b55ec699752d06`, tree `eb5a63a1fdfed5b5f623a4b433544f589c9bf21f`. All four review threads are resolved; native/focused local proof is complete. Run [39510731523](https://github.com/EffortlessMetrics/ripr-swarm/actions/runs/39510731523), attempt 1, failed with `claim_identity_missing` because this body rewrite dropped the admission fields. They are restored below; product source is unchanged. `merge-ready` remains present and auto-merge is null. No duplicate run or label reapplication is requested.

Governing issue or accepted claim: delegated brief input-status repair from the 2026-10-20 04:25 UTC batch; inherited envelope authority #7331; RIPR-SPEC-0010 and RIPR-SPEC-0241.
Acceptance delta (one sentence): Preserve empty and ordinary successful brief selections while refusing parser-limited, parser-unadmitted or truncated diff inputs through the typed non-consumable envelope.

Original base: `1e9468f4b0d133f0a50b64134318763d8cf48beb`.

| Consumer-facing control | Expected result |
| --- | --- |
| Empty patch, empty inventory | Successful empty brief |
| Empty patch or valid mode-only patch, real inventory | Successful disclosed fallback |
| Ordinary patch at admitted file limits | Successful scoped selection |
| Combined, malformed or conflict input, including mixed ordinary input | Typed non-consumable refusal |
| Header-only truncated textual section, alone or after a complete hunk | Same refusal on empty and nonempty inventories |
| Actual excessive path depth, including after an ordinary hunk | Same refusal; bounds retained |
| Git-produced added/removed slash-heavy Rust raw-string text plus a real predicate edit | Success with `changed_line_intersects_seam` |
| Committed refused input through `--base` | Same intake route before inventory |
| File overflow through `check` | Existing `diff_scope_oversized` identity |

Local repair evidence at `fc7e17a4`, 2026-10-20, Linux x86_64/Bash, Rust/Cargo 1.95.0, jobs=2, incremental off, dev debug=0:

- `cargo test --locked -p ripr --test task_first_facade brief_diff_status:: -- --test-threads=1`: 6 passed, 0 failed/ignored, 51 filtered; 28 CLI invocations.
- `cargo test --locked -p ripr --lib analysis::diff:: -- --test-threads=1`: 239 passed, 0 failed/ignored, 11,625 filtered.
- `cargo test --locked -p ripr --lib analysis::pipeline::tests::truncated_ -- --test-threads=1`: 6 passed, 0 failed/ignored, 11,858 filtered.
- Independent exact-commit source/oracle review found no scoped material defect. Shared grammar boundaries, real deep headers, nonempty predicate stimulus and contract mapping were inspected.
- `cargo xtask check-fast`: exit 0, all 15 gates passed; stable selector independently matches all 13 changed paths. Its skipped fixture contracts subsequently passed in precommit.
- `cargo xtask precommit`: exit 0, no skipped commands or limitations; fresh goldens pass without expected-output/fixture/lockfile edits or blessing. Digest `sha256:9c36394e4eefcbdda4647dc82723af171902a60e60c89259bc9856ef5ee7dfce`. All 1521 current golden files match the previously verified archive by bytes, size and mode.

[Full recoverable candidate/repair patches, red/green logs, 54 fresh native reports, independent source review and integration metadata](https://github.com/EffortlessMetrics/ripr-swarm/tree/76a4a913b151796d51c641e283fd2f3c9b3c54c2). GitHub readback matched the 13768-byte manifest SHA-256 `54b8426ed53d1efa5cb9e9f46007b8ce17d496dc0fecdd28dfbd41841d192d19` and 37298-byte full patch SHA-256 `a71465f65913103e2edf19f5450d2840f61c0fa0841099bc5320f07b48a85595`.

[Current exact-head inspection](https://github.com/EffortlessMetrics/ripr-swarm/pull/8961#pullrequestreview-5592727103): no scoped material source/oracle finding; REVIEW_INCOMPLETE pending fresh hosted proof. The two repaired Devin findings have verified replies 4331108478 / 4331109095. Initial resolution writes returned errors with detail not retained. After the exact-head inspection and receiver-verified proof were published, one normal retry succeeded for each thread. Fresh GitHub readback confirms all four review threads are resolved. Source repair and proof precede that bookkeeping; thread state does not repair source.

The tests-only red on published production `1a525eaa` observed both intended defects: truncated input returned exit 0, and valid path-like hunk payload returned exit 2. Each new function stopped at its first failure. The final payload fixture was strengthened afterward with a real predicate edit; no final-stimulus pre-repair red or later-case red execution is claimed.

First requested hosted qualification is **terminal success**, [run 39499639623 attempt 1](https://github.com/EffortlessMetrics/ripr-swarm/actions/runs/39499639623). Actual required Rust checkout `fd2947af890f156aa63abb1c58028ec5345e6a5d`, parents `fc3589098d5b9c9340861f65bbb2ecbf80d95c2f` and `1a525eaa`, tree `8f8bd0d33b1d6e8b5e433ac8f6499732d8b12c1e`: 17,761 nextest tests passed / 4 skipped; doctests 2 passed / 1 ignored. Policy, workspace/all-feature compile, strict workspace Clippy, goldens, fixtures, four verdict corpora and PR evidence passed. This is historical proof for the earlier candidate, not qualification of the repair.

[Retained first qualification logs, terminal metadata, checkout, artifact metadata and companion dispositions](https://github.com/EffortlessMetrics/ripr-swarm/tree/b22e34ddcd34808279b1a5b977182e5e6a02f72c). GitHub readback matched its 3320-byte manifest, SHA-256 `695e715963960bc81c918ec92901f516d6bd8f2817274fdcb9e6f037225958e4`. Rust-only companion and three-platform paste jobs passed. Windows advisory is mixed: 84 gap-artifact, 7 Cargo-home and 1 cache-warning tests pass, while all-target Clippy and a selector receipt fail in unchanged, separately owned surfaces (#8845 / #8849). No full Windows, selector replay or all-feature runtime pass is claimed. Denied diagnostic materialization was not retried.

[Earlier exact-head full patch/local proof and verified golden archive](https://github.com/EffortlessMetrics/ripr-swarm/tree/278cbf64c2364dafb6563c42e3e8b5c86de76a20) remains separately identified. Provider quota is missing review, not a clean result. The two original CodeRabbit findings were repaired/resolved; the later Devin findings are repaired/replied and all four threads are now verified resolved.

Scope: extend the existing parser authority and brief intake; preserve numerical admission limits, review-stream selection, inventory totals/cap accounting and the prior bounded-total worker's candidate/tests. Language admission, binary classification and unknown seam IDs remain outside this claim. No test-adequacy or correctness guarantee. Rollback boundary: this PR's scoped commits. Specs, schema guidance and traceability are updated. Changelog disposition: `changelog.d/brief-parser-refusal-status.md` is a Fixed fragment following the canonical section marker, bullet and trailing reference format.

Owner / governing claim: this worker owns the scoped repair and hosted qualification through terminal inspection; parent retains integration judgment.
Candidate: `fc7e17a409cf81b99c2447a409b55ec699752d06`; original base above. Actual observed GitHub merge subject `7ae2509ba2d4d9173e5d21e8bd3ad306a0be9a53`, parents `a816499ecf9544fe49f3c3ca4d4964584ab02f70` and candidate, tree `a0d5776fdaf3303e5744fc903805f4b51a1f969f`. Only unrelated MCP adapter work changed main since the prior basis; relevant native instructions/workflows, parser, intake and error owner are unchanged. The import conflict is resolved without a restack.
Review: exact-head source/proof inspection linked above; fresh required hosted proof remains outstanding; thread resolution is verified.
Validation: exact-candidate results and immutable receiver-readable evidence above. No local full workspace runtime matrix was repeated.
Dependency: no new prerequisite; separate Windows owners retained. Earlier thread-resolution error detail remains unavailable; the normal-route retries and current resolved state are verified.
Next: validate the restored metadata with the unchanged native admission implementation, then rerun only failed jobs of existing run 39510731523. Preserve ongoing companion runs and verify actual qualification checkout/results.
Holds: no merge, auto-merge, release or deployment.

Resource state: worktree/target retained for this open repair and qualification; target about 3.4 GiB, free about 27 GiB. Original cumulative admission remains 12 GiB growth with 8 GiB reserve, including wrappers, dependencies, artifacts and restoration. Receiver-readable evidence is delivered above; no unrelated cleanup.
